name: workspace
description: File tree pane beside the chat (/tree): the working directory read-only, with live marks on files Claude read, edited or created this session.

language.title: Pane language
language.description: en (English), fr (French) or ar (Arabic, drawn right to left)

maxDepth.title: Deepest folder level
maxDepth.description: Folders deeper than this many levels below the working directory are not opened (1 to 32)

maxEntries.title: Most entries listed
maxEntries.description: The tree stops listing after this many files and folders in all, so huge repositories stay fast (50 to 20000)

showHidden.title: Show hidden files
showHidden.description: List dotfiles and dot folders (.git is always skipped)

showBand.title: Button above the prompt
showBand.description: Show the small Files button in the band above the prompt
